text: You're not even sweating! You didn't collapse on the floor? You didn't fail, so that rep didn't count!
Training to failure on every set feels hardcore. But is it needed?
A big review compared training to failure with stopping a rep or two short.
Muscle growth was similar, as long as the sets were close to failure. Failing every set mostly adds fatigue.
Leave one or two reps in the tank on most sets. Save this.
